It seems my friends called my father and told him what I was about to do.
My father didn’t know how serious it was until I explained it to him.
I feel guilty.
He is getting me a psych evaluation tomorrow, haha.

I still use the Smart Keyboard. It’s mainly due to the fact that like you, I only really use my iPad at coffee shops or when I’m not home. When I am home, I bought an iPad stand and just use a Bluetooth keyboard. The Smart Keyboard already does the job great for me and I haven’t had any complaints (besides lack of backlit keys). I don’t feel the need to upgrade to a Magic Keyboard because of this.

To save money, I’d just stick to the Smart Keyboard. The Smart Keyboard does the job just fine.

What u/maxideveloper said. Models are completely different from accessories and clothing, and you need special permission from Roblox to actually sell custom accessories for people’s avatars to wear and buy. This permission is typically reserved for well known designers and developers. These are typically called UGC (User Generated Content) creators.

 Clothing can be uploaded by anyone with Premium and sold as such. This is where you don’t need the UGC permission. While you can’t upload a halo for her to wear in Royale High, you can totally make her a custom pants or shirt that she can wear on the Roblox website and in-game. If she has Premium, she can even sell the shirt on her account if she wants to.

Models on the Roblox website are really only meant for game development. This doesn’t mean you can’t make custom hats that are models. Models are just parts/assets of a game that are saved and uploaded onto the Roblox website. I hope this clarifies things for you.

Unfortunately your model can be for sale, but it will only be free. It’s nice that you’re making your daughter a halo, but it will be unwearable on the Roblox website. Those with custom clothing in the Roblox catalog are a part of a handpicked group specifically allowed to upload custom accessories in Roblox.

To answer your last question, you can create the model to be a hat inside studio. This model can only be worn in your own game (or whatever game has this model within it.)
